profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
High impact technical program manager, senior software engineer, senior account management, and consulting professional with a history of results and contributions in high-paced team environments. Bringing customer-facing solutions and innovation to the cloud-based technology and intelligence space. Passionate about the potential of SaaS and data solutions – both in content and structure – to be game changers, revenue generators, and cost savers for clients. Evangelizer in the power of collaborative thinking, often leading by example to inspire teamwork and excellence to achieve new revenue goals. Delivers projects on time and on budget while motivating cross-functional teams to excel beyond expectation. Fluent in English, Spanish, Arabic. Proficient in French and Arabic-Iraqi. 

Core Skills:
•	Software Engineering
•	Python, Java
•	Agile, SCRUM, Kibana
•	Customer interaction and developing relationships
•	Team Management, Mentorship and Leadership
•	Technical Program Management
•	Senior-level Written & Oral Presentation
•	Leading without Authority
•	Liaising with outside and international organizations 
•	Software Sales Management
•	Project Management & PMO
•	Technology Implementation
•	Project Implementation Strategies
•	Budgeting

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Updated microservice communication to leverage gRPC/protobuf
- Manage bi-weekly Sprints, tracking sprint milestones and open tickets.
- Maintain and update microservices on AWS GovCloud

positions.title: Director of Account Management / Consultant
positions.description:
Babel Street is a SaaS based suite of products that enables customers of all sizes and complexities to analyze global sources of multi-lingual data for actionable signals in real-time. Discover what matters to you regardless of platform, language, or location. Babel Street enhances your capabilities for public search and makes analysts more efficient.

Java, Python, AWS, REST, Agile, SCRUM

- Traveled to customer locations. Trained 200 new users on how to successfully utilize software suite to increase their organization's productivity.
- Liaised with customer organizations. Gauged customers' business requirements. Met with management to establish future milestones for upcoming Sprints.
- Mentor junior Account Managers and Consultants on best practices.

positions.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
- Managed teams of up to 30 members composed of analytical and technical, and programming teams from geographically separated locations.
- Consulted with outside organizations to provide tailored solutions to technical problems.
- Cultivated a high performing work culture by mentoring, coaching and training more than 50 intelligence professionals in intelligent research.
- Assisted in script writing and data analysis. Java, Python
- Conduct innovative all-source analysis and target development in support of special operations forces deployed within the Middle East and Africa regions.
- Utilize signals, geospatial, human, imagery and open source intelligence in conjunction with Social Networking Analysis (SNA) to identify individuals, networks and patterns within large data sets.
- Provide reach-back support to team members and customers deployed worldwide.
- Integrate and coordinate with Department of Defense, Department of State, Department of Justice and Intelligence Community members on Counterterrorism (CT) topics within the African region.

positions.title: Language Enabled Analyst
positions.description:
Served as part of an award-winning team recognized for excellence in conducting Cyber SIGINT and Cyber Counterintelligence Operations supporting Department of Defense. 
•	Built a strong rapport and long-term relationships to establish new special operations customer base. 
•	Advised senior leadership on any emerging trends found during in-depth research that would benefit FBI investigation.
•	Utilized Arabic and French language skills to fill intelligence collection gaps. 
•	Produced intelligence reports for distribution throughout the intelligence community while maintaining local activity logs, dossiers, and files to accurately track mission critical information.
•	Performed social media and language analysis as well as intelligence reporting to identify and assess on threat tactics, techniques and procedures in cyberspace. 
•	Successfully enhanced customer base into direct support to National Level Special Operations Forces.
